text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I only intended to do some light 
self-training, but I ended up coming quite 
a long way.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is it under construction? There are so 
many giant dump trucks over there...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when I was little, I 
used to admire the dump trucks I saw at 
construction sites...

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Amaziiing! So biiig! So strooong!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mommy! I want to be a dump truck someday 
too!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even to me, it was quite a baffling dream, 
but... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, dump trucks really have a 
flawless structure, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"With a solid center of gravity, it 
reliably holds back a massive volume of 
earth and sand..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even when tilting the bed to discharge all 
the earth and sand at once, the vehicle 
body doesn't waver in the slightest—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ha! The defense-focused Kongo Yaegaki 
style and dump trucks share a deep 
commonality...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps my childhood self sensed that 
instinctively and came to admire it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. From now on, let us devote 
ourselves to achieving the power and 
stability of a dump truck.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Yaeno Muteki's running 
gained a sharper edge!
